import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w = params[0]; p = params[1]
    C = np.cos(w*t); S = np.sin(w*t)
    return (params[2] + params[3]*t + params[4]*C + params[5]*S + params[6]*x + params[7]*v
            + params[8]*np.abs(v)**p + params[9]*x*v + C*x*params[2]*0 + (params[4]*0)
            )
